title: Media Query Blank
question: Fill in the blank to apply a style only when the screen is below 600px

correct.title: Perfect! 🎯
correct.details: The @media rule with max-width: 600px creates a responsive design that applies specific styles when the viewport width is 600 pixels or less. This is essential for mobile-friendly websites!

wrong.title: Not quite right! 📱
wrong.details: The @media rule with max-width: 600px applies styles when the viewport width is 600 pixels or less. This is a key technique in responsive web design to make sites look good on mobile devices.
